name: Band Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Drape the band across your upper back and pin the ends under your palms with your hands just inside shoulder width.
Step your feet back into a straight high plank with your abs and glutes tightly braced.
Bend your elbows straight back alongside your ribs to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press firmly through your palms against the band's tension to straighten your arms back to the plank.
tips: Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels without letting your lower back sag.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs as you lower.
